sum: J.W. Mays, Inc. engages in the owning, operation, and leasing of commercial real estate properties in the United States. Its properties are located in Brooklyn, Jamaica, Fishkill, Levittown, and Massapequa, New York; and Circleville, Ohio. J.W. Mays, Inc. was founded in 1924 and is based in Brooklyn, New York.
ceo: Mr. Lloyd J. Shulman (Chairman of the Board, President & CEO)
